#raw distribution of MC length
n_obs    <- sum(!is.na(eas$ci_cycleLength))
binwidth <- 1
scale_factor <- n_obs * binwidth

#colors
histogram_fill <- "#0072B2"   # blue
median_color     <- "#E69F00"   # orange  
mean_color   <- "#000000"   # black

ggplot(eas, aes(x = ci_cycleLength)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = histogram_fill, color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(eas$ci_cycleLength),
             linetype = "dashed", color = mean_color, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(eas$ci_cycleLength),
             linetype = "dashed", color = median_color, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.3, length = unit(0.02, "npc")) +
  labs(
    x = "Menstrual cycle length (days)",
    y = "Number of cycles"
  ) +
  xlim(15, 60) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

## Variable Selection

```{r}
#create woman-level summaries
woman_summary <- eas %>%
  mutate(ui_thyroid_impute = fct_na_value_to_level(ui_thyroid, level = "0")) %>%
  group_by(ui_userN) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cycle_length = mean(ci_cycleLength, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cycle_length = sd(ci_cycleLength, na.rm = TRUE),
    ui_thyroid_impute = first(ui_thyroid_impute)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    eas_cohort_fortable,
    by = "ui_userN"
  )

#function to create summary table
make_summary <- function(data, var, prevalence_denominator = "women") {

  var_sym <- rlang::sym(var)

  out <- data %>%
    group_by(!!var_sym) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),

      prevalence = case_when(
        prevalence_denominator == "women" ~
          paste0(round(100 * n / nrow(data), 1), "%"),

        TRUE ~
          paste0(round(100 * n / nrow(data), 1), "%")
      ),

      median_within_woman_mean =
        round(median(mean_cycle_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),

      median_within_woman_sd =
        round(median(sd_cycle_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-n) %>%
    rename(
      Predictor_Level = !!var_sym,
      Prevalence = prevalence,
      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length Mean` = median_within_woman_mean,
      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length SD` = median_within_woman_sd
    )

  return(out)
}

#create summaries for woman-level variables
menarche_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_ansMenarche_group"
)

pregnancy_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_recentPregnancy"
)

kids_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_ansKids_group"
)

parity_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_ansParity_impute"
)

pcos_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_pcos_impute"
)

endo_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_endometriosis_impute"
)

thyroid_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_thyroid_impute"
)

activity_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_activitylevel"
)

bmi_summary <- make_summary(
  woman_summary,
  "ui_bmi_cat"
)

#function for cycle-level variables
make_cycle_summary <- function(cycle_data,
                               woman_data,
                               var) {

  var_sym <- rlang::sym(var)

  # prevalence from cycles
  prev_tbl <- cycle_data %>%
    group_by(!!var_sym) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cycles = n()
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Prevalence =
        paste0(round(100 * n_cycles / nrow(cycle_data), 1), "%")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-n_cycles)

  # woman-level summaries
  woman_tbl <- cycle_data %>%
    group_by(ui_userN, !!var_sym) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cycle_length =
        mean(ci_cycleLength, na.rm = TRUE),

      sd_cycle_length =
        sd(ci_cycleLength, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(!!var_sym) %>%
    summarise(
      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length Mean` =
        round(median(mean_cycle_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1),

      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length SD` =
        round(median(sd_cycle_length, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    )

  out <- left_join(
    prev_tbl,
    woman_tbl,
    by = var
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Predictor_Level = !!var_sym
    ) %>%
    select(
      Predictor_Level,
      Prevalence,
      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length Mean`,
      `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length SD`
    )

  return(out)
}

age_summary <- make_cycle_summary(
  eas,
  woman_summary,
  "ci_age_group"
)

spotting_summary <- make_cycle_summary(
  eas,
  woman_summary,
  "ci_spotting_logged"
)

sickness_summary <- make_cycle_summary(
  eas,
  woman_summary,
  "ci_sickness_logged"
)

mood_summary <- make_cycle_summary(
  eas,
  woman_summary,
  "ci_mood_logged"
)
```

```{r}
#combine
clean_summary <- function(dat, predictor_name) {
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Predictor = predictor_name,
      Predictor_Level = as.character(Predictor_Level)
    )
}

final_summary_table <- bind_rows(
  clean_summary(menarche_summary, "Age of Menarche"),
  clean_summary(pregnancy_summary, "Recent Pregnancy"),
  clean_summary(kids_summary, "Children in Home"),
  clean_summary(parity_summary, "Parity"),
  clean_summary(pcos_summary, "PCOS"),
  clean_summary(endo_summary, "Endometriosis"),
  clean_summary(thyroid_summary, "Thyroid Condition"),
  clean_summary(bmi_summary, "BMI Category"),
  clean_summary(activity_summary, "Physical Activity Level"),
  clean_summary(age_summary, "Age Group"),
  clean_summary(spotting_summary, "Logged Spotting"),
  clean_summary(sickness_summary, "Logged Sickness"),
  clean_summary(mood_summary, "Mood Symptom")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Predictor,
    Predictor_Level,
    Prevalence,
    `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length Mean`,
    `Median Within-Woman Cycle Length SD`
  )
```

## Crosstabs/Correlations

```{r}
#Cramér's V
cramers_v <- function(tbl) {
  chi2 <- chisq.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE)$statistic
  n    <- sum(tbl)
  k    <- min(nrow(tbl), ncol(tbl))
  sqrt(chi2 / (n * (k - 1)))
}

#cross-tab with chi-square and Cramér's V
crosstab_summary <- function(data, var1, var2) {
  tbl <- table(data[[var1]], data[[var2]], useNA = "ifany")
  chi <- chisq.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
  v   <- cramers_v(tbl)
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("%s  x  %s\n", var1, var2))
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(round(prop.table(tbl, margin = 1) * 100, 1))
  cat(sprintf("\nCramér's V = %.3f   (p = %.4f)\n", v, chi$p.value))
  cat("Cramér's V: <0.1 negligible, 0.1-0.3 small, 0.3-0.5 moderate, >0.5 large\n")
}

#pairs of interest
crosstab_summary(eas_cohort_fortable, "ui_activitylevel",    "ui_bmi_cat")
crosstab_summary(eas_cohort_fortable, "ui_activitylevel",    "ui_ansMenarche_group")
crosstab_summary(eas_cohort_fortable, "ui_ansMenarche_group","ui_pcos_impute")
crosstab_summary(eas_cohort_fortable, "ui_ansMenarche_group","ui_endometriosis_impute")

#full pairwise Cramér's V matrix (person-level)
predictors <- c(
  "ui_activitylevel",
  "ui_bmi_cat",
  "ui_ansMenarche_group",
  "ui_pcos_impute",
  "ui_endometriosis_impute",
  "ci_age_group"
)

cramer_matrix <- matrix(NA,
                        nrow = length(predictors),
                        ncol = length(predictors),
                        dimnames = list(predictors, predictors))

for (i in seq_along(predictors)) {
  for (j in seq_along(predictors)) {
    if (i == j) {
      cramer_matrix[i, j] <- 1
    } else {
      tbl <- table(eas_cohort_fortable[[predictors[i]]], eas_cohort_fortable[[predictors[j]]])
      cramer_matrix[i, j] <- tryCatch(
        cramers_v(tbl),
        error = function(e) NA
      )
    }
  }
}

print(round(cramer_matrix, 3))
```

```{r}
#reorder levels for table
eas_cohort_fortable <- eas_cohort_fortable %>%
  mutate(
    ui_activitylevel = factor(ui_activitylevel, 
                               levels = c("Not active", "Active", "Very active")),
    ui_ansMenarche_group = factor(ui_ansMenarche_group, 
                                   levels = c("<= 11", "12-13", ">= 14", "Unknown")),
    ci_age_group = factor(ci_age_group, 
                           levels = c("18-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39", "40-45")),
    ui_bmi_cat = factor(ui_bmi_cat,
                        levels = c("Underweight", "Healthy Weight", "Overweight", "Obesity")),
    ui_pcos_impute = ifelse(ui_pcos_impute == 0, "No/Missing", "Yes"),
    ui_endometriosis_impute = ifelse(ui_endometriosis_impute == 0, "No/Missing", "Yes")
  )

#returns a tidy proportion table with Cramér's V
crosstab_tidy <- function(data, var1, var2, var1_label, var2_label) {
  tbl <- table(data[[var1]], data[[var2]], useNA = "ifany")
  props <- round(prop.table(tbl, margin = 1) * 100, 1)
  v <- cramers_v(tbl)
  
  as.data.frame(props) %>%
    rename(!!var1_label := Var1, !!var2_label := Var2, Percent = Freq) %>%
    mutate(CramersV = round(v, 3))
}

#generate each table
predictors <- list(
  list(var = "ui_activitylevel",        label = "Activity Level"),
  list(var = "ui_bmi_cat",              label = "BMI Category"),
  list(var = "ui_ansMenarche_group",    label = "Age at Menarche"),
  list(var = "ui_pcos_impute",          label = "PCOS"),
  list(var = "ui_endometriosis_impute", label = "Endometriosis"),
  list(var = "ci_age_group",            label = "Age Group")
)

pairs <- combn(seq_along(predictors), 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  map(~ list(
    predictors[[.x[1]]]$var,
    predictors[[.x[2]]]$var,
    predictors[[.x[1]]]$label,
    predictors[[.x[2]]]$label
  ))

tables <- map(pairs, ~ crosstab_tidy(
  eas_cohort_fortable, .x[[1]], .x[[2]], .x[[3]], .x[[4]]
))

#print as gt tables
walk2(tables, pairs, function(tbl, pair) {
  
  v_val <- unique(tbl$CramersV)
  
  tbl %>%
    select(-CramersV) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = 2, values_from = Percent) %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title    = sprintf("%s by %s", pair[[3]], pair[[4]]),
      subtitle = sprintf("Cramér's V = %.3f", v_val)
    ) %>%
    cols_label(!!pair[[3]] := pair[[3]]) %>%
    tab_spanner(
      label   = pair[[4]],
      columns = -1
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(decimals = 1) %>%
    tab_source_note("Row percentages. Person-level (N = 16,468 women).") %>%
    print()
})
```
